data.title: Bitcoin Breaks the May High (I Was Wrong)
data.transcript_raw: Hey everyone and thanks for jumping back into the cryptoverse. Today we're going to talk about Bitcoin and I obviously have to do uh my least favorite part of the job and that is admit that I was wrong about Bitcoin not being able to take out the May high. Right? Clearly it has. So, I was wrong and I'm not going to make excuses. I'm not going to, you know, cope uh by looking at other things. I'm just here to say that I was wrong. And, you know, it's tough when this happens. I mean, if you're trying to navigate financial markets, uh there will of course be times when we are all wrong. And uh this is one of those times for me, right? Right? I mean, Bitcoin has accepted here. It it rallied above the 50WE. It is now extended that up to almost 86,000. So, 85,815. So, clearly I was wrong. And you know, I have to deal with a fallout of that. out. My biggest regret is, you know, my strategy this year was to start buying in July below.3 risk, which happened, but it only happened for about 5 days. So, uh, I guess that goes to show you when the opportunities arise to take more advantage of them. Um, because 5 days was obviously not a very long time. And I've I've been in this position before. Um, you know, I've been loved by the world. I've been hated by the world. Uh, so this is not the first time certainly that I've been hated. As I get older, I find myself more so wanting to not be known by the world. Um, but I I you know, Bitcoin breaking through the May high. Um, this is not what I had on my bingo card for this year. And so I just wanted to say I was wrong and leave it at that. Uh there are other people that were right and I think they probably deserve your viewership more uh right now than me. So we're going to wrap it up there. Um and we'll see, you know, we'll see what Bitcoin does for the rest of the year. Thank you guys for tuning in. Uh I actually I just got back from New Zealand. It was a great trip. I hope I can go back. I've always wanted to go there. It was kind of like a lifelong dream of mine to go. So, I'm happy to experience that. And sorry I wasn't able to make videos uh the last couple of weeks. I was just out of town. But I'm back now. And um lucky for me, this is the first video I get to make. So, thank you guys for being here and um uh I will see you later. Bye.
